why: B3 needed an FP32 ONNX of the real weights to run quantisation checks. challenge/export/export_onnx.py on the merged branch cannot take --weights; A2's enhanced exporter lives on the unmerged a2-quantization branch, so B3 ran that file read-only from a scratch copy.
blocker_found: A2's exporter reads FLAT manifest fields (model_id/config_id/weights_sha256 at the top level), while A3's handoff v3 uses the NESTED candidate_identity layout -> it fails with 'weights manifest model_id does not match Student'. B3 solved the same problem on 2026-09-24 for its own loaders (commit 3b09f1f).
workaround: B3 derived a flat view of the manifest in a scratch directory (digest values copied verbatim, nothing invented) so the exporter could run.
scope_note: Raw output tensors are compared, so a pass implies identical decoded plans under the same adapter; this is a graph-equivalence check, not an accuracy claim.
